title: Faryad Hai Faryad
body:
karti thi ye ro ro ke fughan zainab e nashaad
faryaad hai faryaad
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein zehra ka bhara ghar hua barbaad
faryaad hai faryaad
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi ki ani seena e akbar mein lagi hai
kya maa pa bani hai
tasveer e nabi ran mein hui jaati hai barbaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
zeenat ke liye daale hai gardan mein jo quran
surat ke musalman
hum aale payambar hai inhe ye bhi nahi yaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kya na masayeb huwe kya kya na sahe gham
jab qaid huwe hum
har gaam par ek taaza sitam ek nayi uftaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes mein hum ahle haram aise lute hai
sar nange phire hai
ruk jaate to dete thay aziyat sitam eejaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
tapti hui sehra ki zameen raah mein kaante
aur paon mein chaale
ghash khaa ke na gir jaaye kahin sayyed e sajjad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab aun o mohamed hai na abbas na akbar
qasim hai na asghar
har ek ne ghar chod ke maqtal kiya aabaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
roti thi sakina jo kabhi gham se bilak kar
ho jaata tha mehshar
gaalon pa lagate thay tamache sitam eejaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghabrati thi zindan ke andhere mein sakina
dushwaar tha jeena
ab qaid mein soti hai wohi bekas o nashaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
<<DIVIDER>>
sahir ghame shabbir mein aansu na rukenge
ta hashr bahenge
ab hum ko nahi kuch bhi masayab ke siwa yaad
faryaad hai faryaad...
author: Sahir
